artifacts.summary: Revised 10-phase plan (version 2): header-linter debt is now measured by a verified scratch-CWD probe instead of a log-replaying warm build, the new invariant is renumbered to C33 to avoid task 643's C31/C32, and Phases 5-6 gain a start gate on 643.

memory_candidates.content: A warm `lake build --wfail` cannot observe a linter finding whose activation depends on a file outside the module's own trace. Mathlib's linter.style.header gates on isInLibraryRoot, which reads ./<Root>.lean at elaboration time; Lake's module trace does not include the root aggregator, so changing the root re-elaborates nothing and up-to-date modules are replayed from their .trace logs. The build stays green until the next cache miss, then goes red. Zero-footprint authoritative probe: write the would-be root to a scratch dir, cd there, and run `LEAN_PATH=$(lake env printenv LEAN_PATH) lean --root=<repo> -Dweak.linter.mathlibStandardSet=true <repo>/<file>` -- isInLibraryRoot resolves the root path against the process CWD, so nothing enters the shared tree or .lake/build. Also: a module that imports only `Lean` never loads the header linter, so text scanners mirroring the linter over-report it.
